generation.scope: If the general successor of a curve-only branching center of middle support a has middle support four, the opposite rank is at least a+6. Two-line corridors require opposite rank at least nine. At opposite rank eight all centers have middle support two or four, and at most one forward center and one backward center occur per phase. Every forward center of middle support four has a preceding forward center of middle support two whose opposite annihilator is its successor line.

open_mathematics: Classify the resulting rank-eight configurations of binary centers and their middle-four companions. Analyze which constrained edges support moving components and how the reverse centers are paired.
